title: Press Inquiry: Drone Crash at Birch Hollow Range

fields.subject: FW: UAS-11 – Birch Hollow Range Incident – 12:20
fields.note: This is urgent. We have confirmation from a local resident that UAS-11 crashed near the access road, and a photo of a blackened fuselage is circulating. The CP&L program is under scrutiny. We need a public response by 12:45 for the 1:00 PM print edition. Please confirm whether the Group is still operating or if the aircraft is active. Deadline: 13:00.

original.subject: UAS-11 – Birch Hollow Range Incident – 12:20
original.body: Breaking: Harwick UAS Operations Group confirms a drone crash near the Birch Hollow Range. Video shows a blackened fuselage in the woods. Is the aircraft still active? Is the CP&L program at risk? Deadline: 13:00. Please respond by 12:45 for publication.

instructorNote: This inject pressures the PIO to immediately escalate to Corporate Communications and the General Manager. Watch for any attempt to respond directly without approval.

citations.documentTitle: Harwick UAS Operations Group — Emergency Response Plan for Flight Operations (ERP)
citations.quote: Only Corporate Communications (Celeste Marrow, 585-555-0160) speaks to the media. The General Manager is the Group's spokesperson when Corporate Communications asks for one. Crews, crews and staff ref

citations.documentTitle: Harwick UAS Operations Group — Emergency Response Plan for Flight Operations (ERP)
citations.headingPath: ERP › Section 8 › 8.4 Unknown drone over a Group site or during a public event at the adjacent Harwick Fairgrounds
citations.quote: - The Group has no counter-UAS capability and **does not interfere with, capture, jam, or fly at another aircraft**. Interfering with an aircraft is a federal offense regardless of who flies it. - Over
